entries.text: My dear friends! How ARE you all today?\nYou certainly look fantastic![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_01

entries.text: It’s time for another one of Salvatore’s Language\nLessons! Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_02

entries.text: ... ... ...\n... ... ...\r\nAhem. Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_03

entries.text: Y-yes!
entries.label: class_d_03_yes_01

entries.text: O-oui!
entries.label: class_d_03_yes_02

entries.text: Très bien! Very good![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_04

entries.text: My lessons are not a one-way street! Non non!\nI am très triste when no one speaks up!\r\nVery sad, that is![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_05

entries.text: In our last class, I believe I taught you all how to\nsay “delicious” in other languages, right?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_06

entries.text: In le cours d’aujourd’hui—today’s class—we will\nlearn about a very special phrase that you can\r\nput to use when the time is juuust right![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_07

entries.text: Ai shiteiru! Je t’aime! Te amo! Ich liebe dich!\nDoes anyone know what these phrases mean?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_08

entries.text: Time to eat
entries.label: class_d_03_select_01

entries.text: I love you
entries.label: class_d_03_select_02

entries.text: I’m going home
entries.label: class_d_03_select_03

entries.text: Oh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nNon non! We can’t have you eating anyone!\nThat’s a mauvaise réponse—a wrong answer![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_answer_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Fantastique, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Correct!
You
deserve
a
médaille
d’or—a
gold medal![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_answer_02

entries.text: Oh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nNon non! I can’t let you go home just yet!\nThat’s a mauvaise réponse—a wrong answer![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_answer_03

entries.text: Je t’aime! Te amo! Ich liebe dich! These three\nphrases you may know, I think! Why? Because\r\nthey’re all quite famous ways to say “I love you!”[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_09

entries.text: Oh, my! Have I embarrassed you all, my friends?\nWhat timides little garçons et filles—shy boys\r\nand girls, that is![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_10

entries.text: It’s so very important to express your feelings\nabout things to others, you know! This is\r\nESPECIALLY true for positive emotions![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_11

entries.text: If you get married someday and argue with your\nspouse over some silly little thing...[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_12

entries.text: All you have to do is apologize and say “I love\nyou” et tout ira bien—and all will be well, that is![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_13

entries.text: I should know! Why, just last week, I had a big\nargument with ma femme—my dear wife, that is!\r\nBut I was quick to say I’m sorry, and all was well![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_14

entries.text: And now, apropos of nothing, let me give you\nall one of my wise words of advice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_15

entries.text: It’s best to be quick to apologize when you have\nan argument with someone![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_16

entries.text: That goes for your families, friends, AND your\ncrushes! I know you can do it! I believe in you![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_17

entries.text: Our prochain cours—our next class—will be the\nmidterm exam! Be sure to review what we learned\r\nin all our lessons so far! Adios! Mata ne![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_03_language_18
